root_idea.summary: The root centers on retaining or bringing something to mind, from which arise remembering, mentioning, reminding, revealed reminders, and honor through being remembered. A distinct branch concerns the male or masculine and extensions of that notion to strength and related qualities.
root_idea.development: The root principle is described as two main developments: remembering what was forgotten and the resulting remembrance or speech; and the male/masculine branch, with figurative extensions to vigor, hardness, and sharpness.

senses.definition: To remember, recall, or bring something to mind.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes recollection after forgetting and keeping a person or thing mentally present.

senses.definition: To mention, tell, relate, or say something.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to mentioning a person, event, or matter aloud; the contextual force may be neutral, favorable, or reproachful.

senses.definition: To be mindful of something and not neglect it; to heed or attend to it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with a right, claim, favor, instruction, or revealed teaching, with the sense of bearing it in mind and acting accordingly. Devotional remembrance may also include praising and glorifying God.

senses.definition: To remind or cause someone to remember something.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, event, teaching, or matter previously known or liable to be forgotten; in the testimony construction, one woman reminds the other.

senses.definition: To admonish, exhort, or give a reminder.
senses.usage_conditions: Often involves urging obedience and recalling the consequences of conduct, including reward and punishment.

senses.definition: To remember, recall, or take heed.
senses.usage_conditions: The form commonly presents remembering as an inward response to a sign, teaching, warning, or prior knowledge, and may therefore be rendered “take heed,” “learn a lesson,” or “receive admonition.”

senses.definition: To remember or recollect, especially after forgetting.
senses.usage_conditions: The form is a phonologically assimilated recollective counterpart of the remembering branch of the root.

senses.definition: A male; masculine, as opposed to female or feminine.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of human beings, animals, and in the Quranic male–female contrasts; the Quranic forms include singular, dual, and plural expressions.

senses.definition: Remembrance, recollection, or mention; the presence of something in the mind or its expression in speech.
senses.usage_conditions: May be remembrance in the heart, remembrance on the tongue, or continued retention rather than recollection after a lapse.

senses.definition: Devotional remembrance of God: praise, glorification, thanksgiving, obedience, prayer, supplication, or recitation.
senses.usage_conditions: This specialized devotional use is established by the surrounding religious construction rather than by a separate grammatical form.

senses.definition: A revealed book, religious message, or scripture, especially the Quran.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to a prophetic book, a revealed reminder, or the Quran as a source of religious teaching and remembrance.

senses.definition: Honor, eminence, nobility, or renown conferred by being remembered.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage this can describe the honor of a person or people associated with the revelation.

senses.definition: An admonition, warning, or exhortation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of discourse or revelation insofar as it admonishes and warns; this overlaps functionally with “reminder” but is a distinct result of the message.

senses.definition: A repeated or intensified remembrance; a reminder, admonition, or bringing to remembrance.
senses.usage_conditions: The form is stronger or more expressly resultative than ordinary ذِكْر and may denote a reminder that prompts recollection or moral heed.

senses.definition: Repentance or remorseful return to awareness.
senses.usage_conditions: This interpretation is attached in the lexical tradition to a Quranic use of ذِكْرَى; the cited historical reference is not converted here into an unverified modern verse location.

senses.definition: One who remembers, mentions, or engages in remembrance.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrences are feminine plural and masculine plural forms of the same active participle; the citation headword is singular masculine.

senses.definition: One who reminds or admonishes; a reminder-giver.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is predicative and may be rendered “a reminder,” referring to one whose role is to remind.

senses.definition: Mentioned, spoken of, or brought into notice.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use contrasts a state of not yet being an independently existing or mentioned thing with later existence; the participle itself denotes what has been mentioned.

senses.definition: One who remembers, takes heed, or receives admonition.
senses.usage_conditions: The participle denotes a person capable of responding to a reminder or lesson.

senses.definition: A reminder or something by which a matter is brought to mind.
senses.usage_conditions: May denote revelation or admonitory discourse functioning as a means of recollection and moral heed.

senses.definition: Reminding, recalling, or admonishing.
senses.usage_conditions: Names the action expressed by Form II: causing someone to remember or exhorting them through a reminder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek a woman in marriage or address oneself to seeking her in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive use reported in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike a man on the penis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare specialized verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call a story, discourse, or matter to mind with another; hence, to confer with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses reciprocal or associated recollection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call something to mind together; to confer with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI use related to mutual recollection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Praise or good speech of another, and according to some usage, dispraise or evil speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evaluative force is supplied by the accompanying expression or context; it is not inherent in the bare noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fame, renown, report, or reputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be good or bad and refers to a person’s standing or public mention among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written obligation or written claim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression, synonymous with a written instrument or deed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The male organ of generation; the penis or male genitals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes plural expressions such as مَذَاكِيرُ, which can denote the penis with its surrounding parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong, courageous, ardent, vigorous, effective, stubborn, or disdainful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description applied especially to a man; the comparative أَذْكَرُ means more or most acute and effective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tough, strong, and of the best quality, especially of iron or steel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the masculine/strong branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword having a hard or steel edge, a sharp blade, or distinctive watered markings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the construction and quality of a sword rather than to a male object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbs or leguminous plants that are thick, rough, hard, or somewhat bitter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression contrasts these plants with finer or sweeter varieties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perfume regarded as proper for men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited examples include musk, aloes-wood, camphor, and similar scents that leave little stain or dissipate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eminently excellent, strong, or firm; of the Quran, a saying, or poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Classical Arabic application; it is not assigned to the Quranic male occurrences merely because the headword is homographic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something disliked or unwelcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use associated with the traditional dislike of a female animal bearing a male.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Violent rain falling in large drops and bringing intense cold or torrents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of severe or forceful rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Severe, distressing, or hard to endure; of a day in which severe fighting or slaughter has occurred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective applied to difficult times.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name reportedly applied by some Arabs to the star al-Simāk al-Rāmiḥ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare and tentatively reported lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of steel added to the edge of a sword or the head of an axe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical noun associated with the hard or sharp component of a tool or weapon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharpness of a sword or of a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively for a person’s acuteness or forcefulness as well as literally for a blade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cutting or sharp sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use distinct from the ordinary remembrance noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man possessing an excellent memory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective or noun for strong recollective ability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man possessing fame, renown, glory, or boastfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization derived from ذِكْر in the sense of public renown.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The male parts or male-bearing trees of palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use referring to male palm trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beget a male; of a woman, to give birth to a male.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be used of the father or, in the feminine form, of the mother who bears a male child.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female that gives birth to a male, or to male children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also be applied to a female that usually produces male offspring in related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert that produces thick or hard herbs of the kind called ذُكُور.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative land-description based on the botanical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road that is feared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a dangerous or difficult route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman or other female that habitually bears males; also a man who usually begets male children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Expresses a recurring tendency rather than a single birth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land that produces thick or hard herbs of the kind called ذُكُور.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The more common of the reported land-related senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A terrible desert traversable only by strong, courageous, or stubborn men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the strength branch of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Resembling a male in build, character, or disposition; of a female animal or woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a she-camel resembling a he-camel and a woman who makes herself like a male.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe calamity or misfortune, or one that only strong and stubborn people can withstand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative feminine adjective associated with severity and force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A memorandum, biographical memoir, official note, passport, permit, or similar written reminder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These documentary senses are Classical and later administrative extensions, distinct from the Quranic sense of a reminder or admonitory means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of remembrance; reportedly, in a related expression, the Black Stone or corner of the Kaaba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place noun attested in a traditional expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Praised or spoken of well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participle use distinct from the Quranic neutral sense “mentioned.”

lane_unit_coverage.note: Quranic testimony construction and its alternative interpretation.
Anomalous plural of the anatomical sense.

cautions: Historical Lane Quran citations are retained only as lexical evidence; they have not been mechanically converted into modern verse locations.
The repentance interpretation of ذِكْرَىٰ is explicitly reported in the lexical evidence, but its historical citation does not securely identify a supplied modern word location.
The Quranic male noun is kept separate from Classical figurative uses such as strength, sharpness, and excellence.
